diagnosis: The validator required literal range and exposed-header names, rejecting legal wildcard CORS responses for anonymous requests. The actual Source OPTIONS probe succeeds. This is a validator implementation correction, not removal of a required browser check.
interpretation: For requests without credentials, wildcard allow/expose headers have wildcard semantics. A bounded single Range is CORS-safelisted; nonetheless retain the explicit OPTIONS diagnostic and require any actual browser preflight to succeed. Actual Origin GET and readable range headers remain required.

response_headers.access-control-allow-methods: GET, HEAD, PUT, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS
